input.change_text: Fixed an issue where bash commands with backslash-newline continuation lines (e.g., long commands split across multiple lines with `\`) would produce spurious empty arguments, potentially breaking command execution.

output.subject: Bash backslash-newline continuations no longer produce spurious empty arguments
output.action_text: Upgrade Claude Code to 2.1.47 if you run multi-line bash commands joined with `\`. Pre-fix, continuation lines emitted spurious empty arguments — silent argv corruption that could change command meaning without raising a visible error.
